title: Synthia
tagline: It is a AI powered onchain reputation system using Hedera & ASI for secure, verifiable trust scores.
description: Synthia is a decentralized reputation protocol that leverages AI to analyze and score wallet interactions across blockchains. By integrating with Hedera’s fast and cost effective network and ASI’s AI infrastructure, Synthia builds a transparent and immutable reputation layer for Web3. Users receive dynamic reputation scores based on on-chain activity, which can be triggered by specific events , for example, during login or when verifying a user’s network history through a portal. These behaviors are analyzed by AI agents and recorded as verifiable NFT credentials stored in metadata. In the future, this system could evolve into an auto updating NFT reputation model, where new on chain actions adjust a user’s score in real time, similar to a point based reputation system. These reputation scores unlock new forms of decentralized identity, undercollateralized lending, and trust based interactions across Web3 applications.
how_its_made: Synthia is built on a stack that merges blockchain reliability with the power of artificial intelligence. Smart contracts, written in Solidity 0.8.20 and secured with OpenZeppelin, drive a dynamic NFT system on Hedera’s lightning fast network. The frontend, built with Next.js and TypeScript, ensures a smooth and responsive experience. Behind the scenes, an AI driven reputation engine continuously analyzes on chain behavior, making Synthia a trustless and scalable solution for Web3 identity and reputation.
